content.title: Chapter 54 - MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAFFIC — Sec. 54-249. - Penalty.
content.summary:
A violation of this article shall be punishable by a fine not to exceed the limits
               established in
section 1-5
.
(Code 1981, § 17-133; Ord. No. 2804, § 1, 4-15-1991; Ord. No. 2996, § 1, 8-16-1993;
Ord. No. 4561, § 2, 8-29-2016
)
